_readme: Example for scripts/Test-LiveSmoke.ps1 (BUILD-PLAN L0, docs/harness/LIVE.md). Copy it to .env.live-lab/live-config.json or .env.live-customer/live-config.json (gitignored), replace every <...> value and pass -ConfigPath. cloud.* and testClient.* are read only when a token is requested; with -NoToken they may stay as placeholders.
resourceGroup: <resource group of the gateway, apps and Cosmos DB>

gateway.apiPath: <API path with a leading slash, for example /anthropic>
gateway.audience: <gateway application ID URI, for example api://...>
gateway.probeModel: <a model the test identity may call>

testClient.appDisplayName: <display name of the test client application>

network.jumpboxNamePrefix: <prefix no remaining resource may start with>
